title: What the deep says when you clear a floor (by how well you did)
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

s_1.text: Nine souls descended. One returned with maps of the dark. This map shows where the first floor begins.

a_1.text: Nanites sleep in your blood until you bleed them awake. Cut a finger and breathe hard to start the bloom.

b_1.text: The Lodge at Eliet holds supplies for traders. Ask Smith Hale for iron rods to anchor against the void wind.

c_1.text: Apothecary Lin warns that water element nanites turn cold in winter. They freeze in your veins if you stop moving.

d_1.text: Do not chase the light at Floor Fourteen. The Mirror there shows only what you fear. Turn back to the stairs.

items.text: Push east on floor ten to find a door that no map ever shows.
items.title: The Old Stair

items.s_1: Grindstone's Touch — You cleared the room without a scratch, your nanites humming in perfect rhythm.
items.a_2: Stone-Still Heart — The boss fell fast; you found a hidden passage and kept your breathing steady.
items.a_3: Iron-Bound Will — Nine lives lost, one heart remains: you reached the next door with a treasure in hand.
items.b_1: Rusty Blade's Work — You survived the drop, but left half the loot behind; the dungeon still has teeth.
items.b_2: Clumsy Climber — The floor is safer now; your qi stabilizes, yet you missed a key lever nearby.
items.b_3: Weary Traveler — You pushed through fatigue and reached the exit, but the nanites in your blood flickered once.
items.c_1: Fragile Vessel — You barely escaped the trap; check your foundation, or the next fall breaks you.
items.c_2: Lost Compass — The map shows a dead end; retrace your steps to the Jade Pagoda's light.
items.c_3: Cold Sweat — You found the key, but the door is locked; Elder Mo says it needs a blood sacrifice.
items.d_1: Falling Star — You nearly slipped into the dark; stabilize your nanites before descending deeper.
items.d_2: Hollow Core — Time ran out; return to Eliet and rest, or the cold valley takes you.
items.d_3: Broken Step — You missed the exit by inches; the dungeon watches those who rush like a hungry fox.

items.text: Master Elder Mo nods at your return. The nine who left did not come back, but you have the Mirror from floor twenty-five. Keep it dry. It holds the path to Shellhaven.
